run_task: run an ECS task on a cluster with a given task definition, container, command, cpu, and memory
describe_task: describe a single ECS task by its ARN and return its container instance status and IP
describe_tasks: describe multiple ECS tasks by their ARNs and return a list of container instances
stop_task: stop an ECS task on a cluster by its task ARN
list_task_definitions: list all ECS task definition ARNs with pagination support and an optional limit
